attribution: © State of New South Wales (Spatial Services). Extracted 29 October 2026. Display geometry simplified and place-area candidates derived by 1stprincipleai.
aerial_caution: Capture dates vary. Imagery is not a surveyed lot boundary or planning-risk layer.
coordinate_reference: EPSG:4326; ESRI source rings converted to GeoJSON
place_council_match: Finer generalized LGA geometry intersected with generalized suburb polygons; negligible slivers below 0.01% excluded. Navigational candidates only.
postcode_limitation: NSW suburb postal attribute, not Australia Post postcode boundaries or a unique council lookup.

address_search.required: roadName and at least suburb or postCode
address_search.confidence_basis: Inspect numRecs and searchMethod.methodDescriptions. A nearby house or ignored postcode/suburb is not an exact match.
address_search.coordinate_caution: Service example and live response can label GDA94/EPSG4283 even when EPSG4326 requested; not a surveyed parcel point.

national_street_map.coverage: Australia mainland, states and territories; external territory coverage not guaranteed
national_street_map.availability: Best effort, no service guarantee; interactive viewing only, no bulk/offline downloads

national_address_search.limitations: Explicit submit only, limited fair use, no service guarantee, incomplete community data. Street-number points and area results remain distinct; no unit verification or local planning-law coverage outside NSW.

council_type_classification.meaning: Published population and urban-character categories. Not zoning, hazard, buildability or approval confidence.

council_documents.limitation: Official spatial catalogue references and document entry pages; property applicability and current consolidated legislation require verification.
